verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗਰੁ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿ ॥ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: satigur sat satigar ko sabadh sat || sat saadh sa(n)gat hai gurmukh jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: True Lord (Satguru) is truth. His word is truth. His holy congregation is truth but this truth is realized only when one presents oneself before the True Lord (Satguru).
